lena: Quick RFC follow-up: propose a prepare/commit txn for air-gapped seed installs to avoid half-applied bundles.
omar: outline the happy path?
lena: control-plane POSTs /txns -> node reserves staging space + returns resume_token; transfer service streams chunks into CAS; on verify node marks txn PREPARED.
mike: and commit?
lena: control-plane POST /txns/:id/commit -> node atomically swaps activation pointer to manifest hash and clears soft-lock. abort clears staging and releases reserved bytes.
tara: key ops concerns: how to avoid disk storms when many prepares run?
omar: node advertises accepts_prepares + capacity_score. control-plane schedules to capacity. node enforces max_staging_bytes and a token-bucket for inbound streams.
mike: GC implications? multiple activations can reuse blobs if CAS; GC must respect active manifests + soft-locks. propose refcount manifest + TTL-based sweep.
lena: security: signed manifest binding resume_token and manifest hash, so replay is rejected. also require manifest sig verification before finalize.
tara: resilience: node persists txn state so reboot/resume is possible; transfer is chunked with chunk ids so retries are idempotent.
ops-bot: infra: created ticket #1105 "txn-prepare-commit-proto PoC" assigned @lena @mike :eyes: 
lena: next steps: tiny PoC agent implementing CAS finalize, txn state persistence, and capacity hint. will write RFC appendix with API stubs.
mike: I'll prototype a simple refcount store (sqlite) and simulate a 3-node canary to measure staging overhead.
